$comment: T82. Registers the quantdesk MCP connector for the Claude CLI at the project level.
This file is AN INSTANCE of the registration, not the interface. The interface is the
command below: any MCP client that launches a stdio server can be pointed at the same
process, and context/mcp-connector.md gives the generic invocation. Nothing in the tool
DATABASE_URL_RO must authenticate as quantdesk_ro. There is deliberately no fallback to
DATABASE_URL: the server refuses to start rather than run with write access, because a
connector that works perfectly and is not read-only is the worst possible outcome.
The ${VAR} form is expanded by the Claude CLI from the environment or the project .env.
